instruction: Copy file 'config.ini' from 'source_dir' to each of directories 'dir1', 'dir2', 'dir3'.

parameters.command: rm -rf dir1 dir2 dir3 source_dir && mkdir source_dir dir1 dir2 dir3 && echo '[Settings]' > source_dir/config.ini && echo 'version=1.0' >> source_dir/config.ini

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'for d in dir1 dir2 dir3; do if [ -f "$d/config.ini" ]; then echo "Success: config.ini exists in $d."; else echo "Failure: config.ini does not exist in $d."; fi; done'
